name: demo
description: Single-user demo on Sepolia. The user (validator) approves or rejects the AI's code. The judge (a server oracle, here the relayer address) mints a soulbound penalty token when approved code was wrong, and may lift a restriction early (the token stays). Count-based ladder: token n weighs 100 x n and fades 100 per 5 minutes, and any score means 'restricted' (no AI): token 1 = 5 min, token 2 = 10 min, token 3 = banned forever (no fade, no lift).
